description: What exists at a place, and when: dated stills, source quotes and measurements within radius_km of lat/lng or of an entity's site, newest first. Each row carries valid_on (world time) and recorded_at (our time). Filter by dates and kinds; paged. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. With id, centres on that entity's site.

entity_types.description: Comma list of entity kinds to include (deposit, infrastructure, company, project).

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

from_date.description: Only rows valid on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

kinds.description: Comma list of row kinds: still, quote, verdict, match, measurement.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (WGS84). With lng; or name an entity.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging. Default 0.

radius_km.description: Radius in km, up to 50. Default 2.

to_date.description: Only rows valid on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: place_index
